column1: # card_specs.tsv - static intrinsic specs per GPU card (schema group J: card spec table)
# ONE ROW PER CARD this project can schedule. These are the STATIC vendor-datasheet nominal
# values that EXPLAIN why a card wins or loses a run: fp64_tflops is the central prediction for
# PROTEIN (fp64 compute-bound) and mem_bandwidth_gbs is the central prediction for DNA
# (memory-bound). card_sweep.sh joins this table by the `card` key (the gres short name,
# i.e. the CARD env var) and writes these columns into each card-sweep row alongside the runtime
# nvidia-smi measurements, so a reader can rank the cards by intrinsic capability.
# SOURCE: the per-row `source` column is authoritative (vendor datasheet or product brief, NOMINAL
# peak/boost figures for the EXACT variant the harness schedules, i.e. the nvidia-smi product name
# recorded in RUNS.tsv). `derived` = TRUE marks a value not printed by the vendor and computed here.
# Round-8 corrections (author action R21): the teslaV100 row previously held V100 PCIe values
# (7.0 TFLOP/s, 250 W, 32 GB) although the card scheduled is the Tesla V100-SXM2-16GB
# (7.8 TFLOP/s, 300 W, 16 GB); the a100 row held SXM4 bandwidth/TDP (2039 GB/s, 400 W) although
# the card is the A100 80GB PCIe (1935 GB/s, 300 W). FP64 for the A100 is 9.7 in both variants.
# RUNS.tsv keeps the spec snapshot each card-sweep row was written with; this table is the
# reference, and key_numbers.py emits spec_* keys from it for the manuscript.
# UNCERTAIN / DERIVED VALUES (not guessed silently - flagged here per the group-J rule):
#   - fp64_tflops for L40S is DERIVED: the Ada datasheet lists "no FP64", meaning no dedicated
#     fp64 units; fp64 runs at 1/64 of fp32 (~91.6/64 = ~1.4 TFLOPS). Recorded as 1.4 (derived=TRUE).
#   - fp64_tflops for A40/A6000/RTX8000 are the vendor GFLOPS figures (0.58/0.60/0.51) - low by
#     design (1/64 Ampere, 1/32 Turing); exact but easy to mistake for a typo, so noted.
#   - msrp_usd is the single genuinely soft column: launch list price, USD, rounded. Street/OEM
#     pricing varies widely and drifts; treat perf_per_usd as order-of-magnitude only. All MSRP
#     cells are approximate (~).
#   - a100 fp64_tflops=9.7 is the NON-tensor rate; fp64 TENSOR (DMMA) is 19.5 (fp64_tensor=yes).
# `card` KEY must equal the gres short name / CARD env var used by the harness:
#   a100 teslaV100s teslaV100 l40s a40 rtx8000 a6000 (a6000 was never benchmarked; kept for the harness)
card
